tools.name: log_decision
tools.description: Log a signed decision event to the ledger. Managed Mode (default for MCP): omit signing fields and pass agent_name - Audifact securely manages an Ed25519 keypair and signs on behalf of the agent. Events are immutable once recorded; managed mode provides strong auditability after receipt. For maximum

tools.name: log_outcome
tools.description: Log a signed outcome event linked to a prior decision via decision_event_hash. Managed Mode (default): omit signing fields - the managed key from the linked decision's agent is used automatically when the decision was also managed. For client-signed decisions, pass agent_private_key_b64 or agent_pub

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Fetch the public proof payload for one ledger event by its 64-char hex event_hash. When to use: after log_decision/log_outcome when you need trust labels, chain validity, anchor status, or a paired-event proof URL. When NOT to use: to browse many decisions or outcomes — use list_agent_decisions / li

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register or look up an agent identity under the API key's organization. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_proof, list_agent_decisions · Private data: log_decision, register_agent, list_agent_decisions, list_agent_outcomes · Public sink: log_decision.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_proof, list_agent_decisions · Private data: log_decision, register_agent, list_agent_decisions, list_agent_outcomes · Public sink: log_decision

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
